```kotlin
package com.bookreads

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import com.bookreads.api.di.commonApiModule
import com.bookreads.api.di.httpClientModule
import com.bookreads.di.commonStorageModule
import com.bookreads.di.coreStorageModule
import com.bookreads.navigation.NavApp
import com.bookreads.ui.common.AppTheme
import org.koin.compose.KoinMultiplatformApplication
import org.koin.core.annotation.KoinExperimentalAPI
import org.koin.core.module.Module
import org.koin.dsl.KoinConfiguration
import org.koin.dsl.module

expect val appPlatformModule: Module

val appModule: Module = module {}

@OptIn(KoinExperimentalAPI::class)
@Composable
fun KoinApp() {
    KoinMultiplatformApplication(
        config = KoinConfiguration {
            modules(
                appModule,
                appPlatformModule,
                commonApiModule,
                httpClientModule,
                commonStorageModule,
                coreStorageModule,
            )
        },
    ) {
        AppTheme {
            NavApp()
        }
    }
}
```
